en.hubeali: H 14613 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washa, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws
having said that: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gave Permission for the destruction of the Clan of Umayya seven days after their burning of the body of Zayd’.
en.sarwar: 165. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washa, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said that:
‘Allah (azwj) Gave Permission for the destruction of the Clan of Umayya seven days after their burning of the body of Zayd’.
